events.question: How many customer users were active in the last 30 days?

intent.status: Found users and events for activity check

events.label: Found users and events for activity check

plan.headline: Counts distinct customer users with qualifying activity in the active window, with a daily trend and a breakdown by role.

metrics.title: Active customer users
metrics.description: Distinct users with at least one qualifying event in the active window ending on the as-of date, excluding internal users and, by default, test organizations.

metrics.title: Daily active users
metrics.description: Distinct users with at least one qualifying event on each day over the active window, bucketed by day in the chosen timezone.

metrics.title: Active users by role
metrics.description: Distinct active users in the active window grouped by role (owner, admin, member, viewer).

assumptions.label: Active window
assumptions.rationale: The question asks about the last 30 days, so a user counts as active if they had qualifying activity in that many days.

assumptions.label: Activity definition
assumptions.rationale: Any event (login or feature use) counts as activity by default, since both show a person actively using the product.

assumptions.label: Exclude test orgs
assumptions.rationale: The data dictionary says test organizations are QA, demo and load-test tenants that should be excluded from business metrics.

assumptions.label: Exclude internal users
assumptions.rationale: Internal staff are not customers, so they are left out of customer user counts.

assumptions.label: Timezone
assumptions.rationale: Day boundaries for the window and the daily trend depend on the timezone; UTC is a neutral default.

events.sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT ((:as_of::date - :active_window_days::int + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text) AS win_start, (((:as_of::date) + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text) AS win_end), active AS (SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.role FROM northwind.events e JOIN northwind.users u ON u.id = e.user_id JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = u.org_id CROSS JOIN bounds b WHERE e.occurred_at >= b.win_start AND e.occurred_at < b.win_end AND (:activity_type::text = 'any_event' OR (:activity_type::text = 'login_only' AND e.type = 'login') OR (:activity_type::text = 'feature_used_only' AND e.type = 'feature_used')) AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false) AND (NOT :exclude_internal_users::boolean OR u.is_internal = false)) SELECT role AS label, count(*) AS value FROM active GROUP BY role ORDER BY value DESC
events.explanation: Counts distinct users with a qualifying event in the window of active_window_days ending on the as-of date (inclusive, in the chosen timezone), after applying activity type, test-org and internal-user filters, grouped by role.

events.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT (:as_of::date) AS as_of_date, :active_window_days::int AS win), days AS (SELECT generate_series((p.as_of_date - p.win + 1)::timestamp, p.as_of_date::timestamp, interval '1 day')::date AS d FROM params p), bounds AS (SELECT ((p.as_of_date - p.win + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text) AS start_ts, ((p.as_of_date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text) AS end_ts FROM params p), activity AS (SELECT (e.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text)::date AS d, e.user_id FROM events e JOIN users u ON u.id = e.user_id JOIN organizations o ON o.id = u.org_id CROSS JOIN bounds b WHERE e.occurred_at >= b.start_ts AND e.occurred_at < b.end_ts AND (:activity_type::text = 'any_event' OR (:activity_type::text = 'login_only' AND e.type = 'login') OR (:activity_type::text = 'feature_used_only' AND e.type = 'feature_used')) AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false) AND (NOT :exclude_internal_users::boolean OR u.is_internal = false)), daily AS (SELECT d, count(DISTINCT user_id) AS dau FROM activity GROUP BY d) SELECT days.d AS x, COALESCE(daily.dau, 0) AS y FROM days LEFT JOIN daily ON daily.d = days.d ORDER BY days.d
events.explanation: Counts distinct qualifying users per day in the chosen timezone over the window ending on the as-of date (inclusive), filling days with no activity with 0 and applying activity type, test-org and internal-user filters.

events.sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT ((:as_of::date - :active_window_days::int + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text) AS start_ts, (((:as_of::date) + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text) AS end_ts), prev_bounds AS (SELECT ((:as_of::date - 2 * :active_window_days::int + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text) AS start_ts, ((:as_of::date - :active_window_days::int + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text) AS end_ts), qualified AS (SELECT e.user_id, e.occurred_at FROM events e JOIN users u ON u.id = e.user_id JOIN organizations o ON o.id = u.org_id WHERE (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR NOT o.is_test) AND (NOT :exclude_internal_users::boolean OR NOT u.is_internal) AND (:activity_type::text = 'any_event' OR (:activity_type::text = 'login_only' AND e.type = 'login') OR (:activity_type::text = 'feature_used_only' AND e.type = 'feature_used'))) SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT q.user_id) FROM qualified q, bounds b WHERE q.occurred_at >= b.start_ts AND q.occurred_at < b.end_ts) AS value, (SELECT count(DISTINCT q.user_id) FROM qualified q, prev_bounds p WHERE q.occurred_at >= p.start_ts AND q.occurred_at < p.end_ts) AS previous_value
events.explanation: Counts distinct non-internal, non-test-org users with a qualifying event in the window of active_window_days days ending on the as-of date (inclusive, in the chosen timezone), with the preceding equal-length window as previous_value.

review.summary: The query correctly counts each active customer user once, grouped by role, over a 30-day window ending on the as-of date, excluding test orgs and internal users.

events.final_sql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT ((:as_of::date - :active_window_days::int + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text) AS win_start, (((:as_of::date) + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text) AS win_end), active AS (SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.role FROM northwind.events e JOIN northwind.users u ON u.id = e.user_id JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = u.org_id CROSS JOIN bounds b WHERE e.occurred_at >= b.win_start AND e.occurred_at < b.win_end AND (:activity_type::text = 'any_event' OR (:activity_type::text = 'login_only' AND e.type = 'login') OR (:activity_type::text = 'feature_used_only' AND e.type = 'feature_used')) AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false) AND (NOT :exclude_internal_users::boolean OR u.is_internal = false)) SELECT role AS label, count(*) AS value FROM active GROUP BY role ORDER BY value DESC

review.summary: The daily trend counts customer users correctly, but its window includes today (the as-of date), which has no complete data, so the chart ends on a misleading near-zero point; the rewrite uses the 30 full days before the as-of date.

issues.message: Window runs from as_of - win + 1 through as_of inclusive, so the last x is 2026-10-28 (today, data ends 2026-10-27) and shows a false drop; use days as_of - win through as_of - 1 with end_ts at as_of midnight in :timezone.

review.summary: The count is correct, but the 30-day window includes today (2026-10-28), which has no data yet, so it really covers 29 days and is compared against a full 30-day prior period.

issues.message: bounds.end_ts is :as_of + 1, so the window includes today (as_of), which has no events yet (data ends 2026-10-27); shift both windows to end at :as_of exclusive so they cover 30 complete days each.
